wxScheduler: a schedule widget for wxPython (day, week and month views).

Source:
    wxScheduler 1.3, Google Code svn r151 (2014-03-09). The project is

    is maintained in Task Coach. Its readme was dropped when the module
    was unpacked into the tree in 2024 (commit 0751ddfe4) and restored
    here.
